question: Should OpenClaw add `agents.list[].subagents.workspace` for same-agent default child workspace isolation, or keep explicit target-agent profiles plus `requireAgentId` as the supported boundary?
rationale: This would add public config and alter child-session workspace file access, which source inspection cannot safely decide without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Explicit Profiles
options.body: Preserve the current model where isolation requires named child agent profiles and `requireAgentId`, with docs or diagnostics improvements if maintainers want lower setup friction.

options.title: Add Narrow Opt-In Config
options.body: Implement `subagents.workspace` only for same-agent default child spawns, with strict schema, docs, doctor/security review, and focused workspace regression coverage.

options.title: Defer To Broader Workdir Design
options.body: Hold this until subagent workspace, task `cwd`, sandbox policy, and skill workdir isolation are designed together with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87253.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Profiles
recommendation.body: Preserve the current model where isolation requires named child agent profiles and `requireAgentId`, with docs or diagnostics improvements if maintainers want lower setup friction.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work is closest to the spawned workspace override/security-boundary decision this issue asks to change.
